product: Prediction-market event contracts: contracts paying 1 USD, 156M USD of Q2 revenue on a record 13.6bn contracts, over 10x YoY (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29). Also Agentic Trading (about 100k accounts, over 100M USD AUC), Robinhood Chain and Stock Tokens, Gold Card over 1M customers, retirement and Trump Accounts, per the same 8-K.
demand: Volume-led. Q2 transaction revenue 776M USD, up 44pct; event contracts 13.6bn contracts at roughly one cent each; August averaged 152M contracts a day, 14x YoY but down 23pct from July; options up 29pct, equities up 95pct on volume; crypto down 38pct (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29; Motley Fool 2026-09-25).
pricing_power: A court or state order forcing event-contract withdrawal (Missouri order 2026-09-16; appellate court allowed Nevada enforcement, Blockonomi 2026-09-25); per-contract pricing near one cent compressed by competition; heavier marketing and June 2026 restructuring expense; lower short rates cutting net interest revenue; a crypto downturn (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
competition: Closest substitutes are US prediction-market rivals Kalshi and Polymarket plus offshore sportsbooks; brokerage Public debuted AI agents for prediction-market trading 2026-09-24 (MarketBeat). No Chinese low-cost substitute was found in this segment; offshore crypto exchanges remain the alternative. A China-specific peer was not found.
market_strategy: Tenev 2026-07-29: product velocity is focused on one goal, making everyone an owner, with 13 business lines targeted at 100M-plus annualized revenue (SEC 8-K). The 2026-09-29 keynote will unveil the newest updates for active traders (Newsroom 2026-08-10). Tenev 2026-09-21: Trump Accounts could be the biggest element of long-term saving within a decade (247wallst).
bull: Q2 2026 8-K (2026-07-29): revenue $1.31bn +32%, EPS $0.62 vs $0.44 est, record $22bn net deposits; event contracts $156M, 10x YoY; 13 raises in 90d.
bear: August event-contract volume fell 23% from July; Missouri cease order 2026-09-16; crypto revenue -38% YoY; CEO sold ~$62.7M stock 2026-09-21/22; mean target $130.7 below $119.4 price.
falsifier: Q3 2026 print (est. 2026-11-04) shows event-contract revenue below Q2's $156M, or another large state orders withdrawal beyond Missouri's 2026-09-16 order.

Also Agentic Trading (about 100k accounts, over 100M USD AUC), Robinhood Chain and Stock Tokens, Gold Card over 1M customers, retirement and Trump Accounts, per the same 8-K.
web_price_volume_mix: Volume-led. Q2 transaction revenue 776M USD, up 44pct; event contracts 13.6bn contracts at roughly one cent each; August averaged 152M contracts a day, 14x YoY but down 23pct from July; options up 29pct, equities up 95pct on volume; crypto down 38pct (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29; Motley Fool 2026-09-25).
web_bottleneck: Legal and regulatory limits on event contracts: six-state gambling-loss suits, tribal suits over sports contracts, a Massachusetts review, and a Missouri cease order 2026-09-16 (Blockonomi 2026-09-25; Motley Fool 2026-09-25). Secondary constraints are revenue concentration in market activity and short rates, plus weak crypto volume, per the Q2 2026 8-K.
web_who_benefits_next: Event-contract venues and infrastructure: the Robinhood-Susquehanna Rothera/MIAX exchange and sponsors Cboe, CME and Nasdaq (Newsroom 2026-08-10). Routing partners Crypto.com and OG.com (Newsroom 2026-09-08). Trump Account plumbing: State Street funds and BNY (247wallst 2026-09-21). Tokenization, clearing and API vendors stand to gain as well.
web_who_loses: Sportsbooks and prediction-market rivals Kalshi, Polymarket and DraftKings cede retail share, and traditional brokers such as Schwab, Interactive Brokers and Webull lose share (MarketBeat 2026-09-25). Robinhood itself loses on crypto, already down 38pct YoY to 100M USD in Q2 (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
web_margin_collapse_risk: A court or state order forcing event-contract withdrawal (Missouri order 2026-09-16; appellate court allowed Nevada enforcement, Blockonomi 2026-09-25); per-contract pricing near one cent compressed by competition; heavier marketing and June 2026 restructuring expense; lower short rates cutting net interest revenue; a crypto downturn (SEC 8-K 2026-07-29).
web_low_cost_substitute: Closest substitutes are US prediction-market rivals Kalshi and Polymarket plus offshore sportsbooks; brokerage Public debuted AI agents for prediction-market trading 2026-09-24 (MarketBeat). No Chinese low-cost substitute was found in this segment; offshore crypto exchanges remain the alternative. A China-specific peer was not found.
web_ceo_promised: Tenev 2026-07-29: product velocity is focused on one goal, making everyone an owner, with 13 business lines targeted at 100M-plus annualized revenue (SEC 8-K). The 2026-09-29 keynote will unveil the newest updates for active traders (Newsroom 2026-08-10). Tenev 2026-09-21: Trump Accounts could be the biggest element of long-term saving within a decade (247wallst).
web_did_they_deliver: Yes on near-term targets. Q2 2026 (2026-07-29): revenue 1.31bn USD up 32pct, net income 573M USD up 48pct, EPS 0.62 versus 0.44 estimate; record net deposits 22bn USD; Gold 4.8M up 39pct; Legend and Credit Card joined the 100M-plus lines (SEC 8-K). RVII priced at 225.5M USD on 2026-08-13 (Newsroom).
web_what_would_falsify: An order or appellate ruling forcing withdrawal of event contracts in additional large states beyond Missouri (2026-09-16), or Q3 event-contract revenue below Q2's 156M USD with further volume declines (August was down 23pct from July), or a broader trading and crypto slump at the Q3 print expected 2026-11-04 (MarketBeat).
